meta.disclaimer: Planning reference only — Savanna Explorer does not sell insurance. Compare policies and read exclusions before purchase. Confirm evacuation cover, rental terms, and cross-border driving with your insurer and rental company.

intro: Southern Africa self-drive and safari trips need more than standard holiday cover. Medical evacuation to Johannesburg or Nairobi, gravel-road rental damage, and COMESA third-party motor insurance are the gaps travellers miss most often.

mustVerify.title: Medical evacuation (Medivac)
mustVerify.body: Remote lodges and bush camps are hours from major hospitals. Look for USD 250,000+ evacuation cover to South Africa or Kenya, including air ambulance and repatriation. Confirm the insurer accepts your activities (walking safari, mokoro, scuba).

mustVerify.title: Rental vehicle & gravel roads
mustVerify.body: Standard credit-card rental waivers often exclude gravel damage, tyre punctures, underbody strikes, and windscreen chips. Read the rental T&Cs — many Kruger and Namibia routes are gravel. Cross-border use requires written permission from the rental company.

mustVerify.title: COMESA Yellow Card vs comprehensive
mustVerify.body: The Yellow Card is minimum third-party motor liability for COMESA countries — not theft, collision, or medical cover. Buy before the border queue via AA South Africa or your insurer. See our cross-border guides for which posts still sell border insurance.

mustVerify.title: Activity & cancellation exclusions
mustVerify.body: Check exclusions for helicopter flights, scuba, horse riding, and high-risk wildlife activities. Trip cancellation and curtailment matter for seasonal routes — cyclone season in Mozambique, flood closures in Okavango.

checklist: Emergency evacuation to Johannesburg, Cape Town, or Nairobi included
24/7 assistance line with English support in your timezone
Rental car damage — gravel, tyres, windscreen, underbody
Cross-border driving permitted and named countries match your route
COMESA Yellow Card or equivalent third-party motor cover
Walking safari and guided bush activities not excluded
Gear cover for cameras, binoculars, and drones if applicable
